description: Diagnoses the user's local dev environment in one call: health verdict with the likely cause and a suggested fix, framework, git state (branch, uncommitted and conflicted files), dev server ports and who holds them, the 10 most recent log errors, and runtime versions. Call this first whenever the user reports something broken, before asking them what's wrong. Use the other tools only to dig deeper.

cwd.description: Absolute path to the project root. Optional: defaults to the client's workspace root, or the server's working directory.

name: get_session_snapshot
title: Dev environment snapshot
